items.summary_en: Kilo Code for JetBrains is a fully native, open-source coding agent built specifically for JetBrains IDEs, rather than a web-based or external plugin tool. Because it runs inside the IDE, developers can get AI-agent assistance while staying in the editor they already use. It is aimed at JetBrains users who want the flexibility of an open-source coding agent in their existing toolchain.

Developers deciding whether to migrate from Cursor to Codex will find this firsthand perspective useful.

items.title: 李飞飞首个多模态世界模型 Atlas 正式发布：从零开始预训练，几张图就能构建世界
items.summary_zh: World Labs 发布多模态世界模型 Atlas，采用从零预训练的自回归扩散 Transformer，原生处理文本、图像、视频和 3D 数据。它能从一张或数十张图重建三维场景，并生成最长 1 分钟的 1440p 视频；相机位姿作为输入，因此支持可控运镜。该模型面向部分合作伙伴开放早期访问，将用于后续产品。
items.summary_en: World Labs, founded by Fei-Fei Li, unveiled Atlas, a multimodal world model pre-trained from scratch with an autoregressive diffusion Transformer natively handling text, images, video and 3D data. Given one or dozens of photos, it can reconstruct 3D scenes and render videos up to one minute at 1440p; camera pose is a first-class input, enabling controllable camera movement. Atlas is now in early access for select partners and will underpin future products.

items.title: Diagrid Catalyst 2.0 发布，为 AI 智能体新增持久化、可验证的执行能力
items.summary_zh: Diagrid 于 2026 年 7 月 28 日发布 Catalyst 2.0，为 LangGraph、Google ADK、Dapr Agents 等框架的智能体增加持久化执行：模型调用与工具调用以工作流活动记录，中断后可续跑，避免对已完成调用重复付费。可验证性来自 Dapr 1.18，历史经批量哈希与签名后可在应用之外校验；签名默认关闭且依赖 mTLS，蔡司（ZEISS）是早期用户。
items.summary_en: On July 28, 2026, Diagrid shipped Catalyst 2.0, adding durable, verifiable execution for AI agents built with LangGraph, Google ADK, Dapr Agents, and other frameworks. Ten framework integrations are supported; model and tool calls are recorded as workflow activities so interrupted runs resume without redoing completed calls. The verification layer, inherited from Dapr 1.18, hashes and signs workflow history for validation outside the originating app — signing is off by default and requires mTLS. Zeiss is an early adopter.

items.summary_zh: R20 Quantum Trader 以 MIT 协议完整开源；v7.0.0 把策略提示词、模型/API 供应商和 Python 物理拦截插件改为后台可视化配置与热插拔，并支持每 6 小时自进化。它配合 1H ATR 宽止损和 0.8R 浮盈后移至保本位的出场逻辑，减少网格/均线策略在噪声行情中被反复扫损，适合研究 AI Agent 交易的开发者。
items.summary_en: R20 Quantum Trader is a crypto quant trading project now fully open-sourced under MIT. Its v7.0.0 rewrite exposes strategy prompts, model/API providers, and Python-based interception plugins through a visual admin panel with hot swapping, plus a six-hourly self-evolution loop. It also applies ATR-based wide stops and moves stops to breakeven after 0.8R profit to reduce stop-outs in noisy markets, which is useful for teams building AI-agent trading experiments.

items.title: 3个月拿下 3000 star，只因我们比 MinerU 多做了这件事
items.summary_zh: Knowhere 是一个定位为“复杂文档与 AI Agent 之间 Memory Layer”的开源项目，5 月发布完整技术栈，约 3 个月在 GitHub 收获近 3000 star。与把 PDF 转成 Markdown 的 MinerU 不同，它在解析和向量化之间重建文档层级，让每个 chunk 知道自己所属章节和上下文，减少 RAG 检索时的结构信息丢失。
items.summary_en: Knowhere is an open-source project positioning itself as a memory layer between messy documents and AI agents; its full stack was released in May and has gathered nearly 3,000 GitHub stars in about three months. Unlike MinerU, which focuses on converting PDFs into Markdown, Knowhere reconstructs document hierarchy between parsing and vectorization so each chunk knows its section and context. This is especially relevant for teams whose RAG pipelines lose too much structural information.

items.title: 从内部 Side Project 到 3.9 万开发者使用，Kiro Crew 创造者亲述开发幕后
items.summary_zh: Kiro Crew 是由三名亚马逊云科技工程师业余开发、基于 Kiro CLI 的持续运行 AI 开发工作区，现已开源，不到半年已有超过 3.9 万开发者和近 500 名贡献者。它跨 Session 保留状态与任务进度，沉淀 Lessons 和 Skills，解决多 Agent 上下文割裂、CI 后需要人工接续的问题；核心创造者陈柏霖将于 9 月 4 日直播演示这种机制。
items.summary_en: Kiro Crew is an open-source, continuously running AI development workspace built on Kiro CLI by three engineers at Amazon Web Services as a side project; within six months it has exceeded 39,000 developers and nearly 500 contributors. It preserves state and progress across sessions and turns corrections and repeated workflows into Lessons and reusable Skills, coordinating multiple agents so work can keep moving until a human reviews it. Core creator Chen Bolin is scheduled to demo it on September 4.

items.summary_en: Casbin Gateway is an Apache 2.0 local management console rather than another coding agent, shipped as one Go+React binary for Windows, Linux, and macOS. It scans installed agents, centralizes their configs, MCP servers, and permissions, and can sit at localhost:17000 as a proxy to audit every request, tool call, and cost. That helps developers catch model resellers that serve a different model than advertised.

items.summary_en: A developer in his 40s, laid off earlier this year, launched zipo.pics, an image compression site whose Rust-to-WASM core keeps images in the browser and never uploads them to a server—a privacy-oriented pitch for overseas users. The author’s write-up details real issues with Cross-Origin Isolation, OAuth popups, and multithreaded WASM, making it useful for developers working on WebAssembly or client-side privacy tools.
